title: Semaglutide Injection in Indian Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Randomised, Phase III, Active‐Controlled Study
comparison_or_design: The primary synthetic-semaglutide comparison in the Indian phase III study.
time_scope: Baseline to week 24 in the primary per-protocol efficacy population.
excluded: ITT/sensitivity analyses, earlier visits, HbA1c achievement categories and BMI
Lipids, blood pressure, safety and immunogenicity
population_or_material: The per-protocol efficacy population in the Indian phase III semaglutide non-inferiority study.
requested_items: Primary per-protocol Week-24 arm changes for all four requested observations and reported between-group estimates or independent tests; also reported percentage weight loss. HbA1c non-inferiority applies only to HbA1c. Exclude ITT sensitivity results, earlier visits and threshold-achiever endpoints.
